site.about:
Silvermax Courier is a global logistics company built on one promise: your consignment arrives safely and on time. From a single parcel to full container loads, our team handles pickup, customs and last-mile delivery so you never have to worry.

Every shipment gets a unique tracking code, so you can see exactly where it is at any moment.
site.features:
🛡️|Insured Consignments|Optional cover for high-value goods, from pickup to doorstep.
📡|Live Shipment Tracking|Follow every stage of your consignment with a code.
🧰|Secure Packaging|Professional handling and packaging for fragile items.
site.title: Fast, reliable delivery, anywhere in the world
site.sub: Track your parcel in real time and ship with confidence. Silvermax Courier moves your shipments safely from door to door.
site.services:
🚚|Express Delivery|Time-critical parcels delivered fast with live status updates.
✈️|International Air Freight|Reliable air cargo to hundreds of destinations worldwide.
🚢|Sea Freight|Cost-effective container and bulk shipping for large consignments.
📦|Door-to-Door Pickup|We collect from your location and deliver to the receiver's door.
🏬|Warehousing|Secure storage and fulfilment for growing businesses.
🛃|Customs Clearance|Smooth handling of import and export documentation.
